summary: Backend auth (JWT email/password + Emergent Google) and frontend Routine 360° auth-gated flow fully verified. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass. End-to-end UI flow (auth gate → register → type Visage → subtype Skincare → product grid → select 3 → recap → generate → /resultats-routine) works as specified.

issues: After generating, every section renders 'Aucun produit trouvé dans notre base pour cette catégorie.' for skincare slugs (savon/nettoyant, eau micellaire, tonique). The backend catalog has Visage products but the results page mapping does not surface them. Out of scope of this review request but worth flagging.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for a11y compliance.

action_items: (Out of review scope) /resultats-routine returns no matched products for selected skincare slugs — check products mapping/lookup logic.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to AuthModal and ProductFilterModal DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py build_router returns a tuple (router, current_user) but uses @router decorators — fine, just note: current_user is exposed for future protected routes; presently unused outside the module.
JWT secret loaded from os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] at call time via _secret() — good, fails fast if missing.
Mongo _id and password_hash correctly excluded from public user objects (_public helper + projection on /me).
Routine360Page.jsx is ~377 lines and contains multiple step components inline; consider splitting into sub-components (StepType, StepSubtype, StepProducts, StepRecap) for maintainability.

AuthContext.exchangeGoogleSession is defined but not destructured in the provider value — exposed via context only because `googleLogin` is. If you want to call it from /auth/callback, expose it in the value object explicitly.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@beautifyvision.fr / Admin1234! (verified working). Test users created via /api/auth/register with unique emails — auto-cleanup not implemented but they are TEST_-style ephemeral.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test run creates one ephemeral test user via /api/auth/register (email test_<uuid>@beautifyvision.fr). Frontend test also creates one via UI signup. No cleanup performed — emails are unique per run so no collision risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from frontend/.env: https://makeup-match-test.preview.emergentagent.com (review_request URL was different — use frontend/.env value). Auth endpoints all working: /api/auth/register, /login, /me, /google-callback. JWT bearer in Authorization header. Admin seeded via seed_admin on startup. Routine360 step machine: 0=auth, 1=type, 2=subtype (visage only), 3=products, 5=recap; useEffect auto-advances 0→1 on login. Available product tile slugs in skincare section include nettoyant, eau-micellaire, tonique (used for testing). Note: /resultats-routine shows 'Aucun produit trouvé' for all selected skincare slugs — results lookup may be broken or not yet wired to catalog; not part of this review request.
